The Voting Rights Act wasn't about giving Black voters special treatment. It was about stopping hostile politicians from using fake excuses — "it's just about literacy" — to hide what they were actually doing. It let courts look past the excuses and take account of the results. That protection is now gone.

The high court has essentially decreed that we are in a post-racial nirvana. But that declaration from on high doesn't make racism disappear. It just makes it invisible to the courts. And it

There's still a deal available. We need a grand bargain on voting in America. Our democracy might depend on it. 
Here’s my proposal: vanjones.substack.com/p/will…

Here's the problem with redrawing maps. You're telling some voters they matter more than others. That's not how a democracy works.

Last week the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act. Tennessee moved within days - carving up Memphis's majority-Black district. The state's only Democratic seat. Gone. 

A Republican senator said it on the record, “This bill represents Tennessee's attempt to maximize our partisan advantage."

Not election security. Partisan advantage.

Erica Kirk, a grieving widow, has tremendous moral authority and standing in our country. If she chooses to do so, she can become a much-needed leader in the fight against political violence in America. She can succeed in this cause ONLY if she is willing to call out violence and dehumanization on all sides — left, right and in between. ⁨The Voting Rights Act was the crowning achievement of the Civil Rights movement. The law that finally made America a true democratic republic. John Lewis was beaten nearly to death to get it passed. Dr. King gave his life to the cause. Today, the Supreme Court gutted it.

His statement outraged many — who now just want to write him off. That's a mistake. He has a massive audience and is emerging as one of the major voices of his generation. Those of us who disagree owe him — and his audience — a real argument.

Everyone with a platform has a duty to fight any attempt to dress him up as some kind of anti-establishment role model. He’s not. People like him need to be removed from society and given help. There was a time when anyone in the MAGA coalition who dared defy Donald Trump would be immediately smeared and sidelined by a vengeful president. Trump presented himself as a world conqueror who would brook no dissent. Those days are over! WOW! @CarissaVeliz  delivered this year one the most astute, original and insightful TED talks I have heard in a very long time. I never saw technologists who are making bold PREDICTIONS as sinister actors who are exercising POWER over others — and the future. Listen to this talk. A star is born! Veliz is a new kind of public figure — a prophet against prophecy. ted.com/talks/carissa_veliz_…

As we reflect on the 10-year anniversary of the death of Prince, I want to share a happy moment. During the 2012 election season, Prince, Rosario Dawson and I went on the View to announce Rebuild The Dream and encourage people to use their voices for change. It was a thrilling moment— and it kicked off a powerful concert series and campaign. He never had never done anything like that before.

Trump’s former Secretary of Labor Lori Chavez-DeRemer and his former head of Homeland Security Kristi Noem BOTH left office recently in the midst of messy scandals. The Trump administration has a surplus of drama — but a deficit of attention to the things most Americans care about (like lower prices).

It's been more than 45 days since Iran's internet went dark. And the Iranian regime is burning through MILLIONS per day to keep 92 million people offline.

Why spend so much to silence your own country? Because when you control the internet, you control the story. When a government won't let its OWN PEOPLE speak, question the narrative the outside world is hearing.

ORBAN’S FALL IS “BREXIT IN REVERSE”: A major overseas election outcome can foretell what’s coming to the USA. Brexit’s passage in the UK in 2016 foreshadowed Trump’s rise that year. Ten years later, Orban’s defeat in Hungary foreshadows the defeat of Trump’s project here in 2026.
